My fix log

Every time you solve something, write down what went wrong and how you fixed it. Tap any entry to open it. Reference notes, guides and cheat sheets are in the M365 Reference Hub, Knowledge Base tab.

Log a fix

Formatting: start a line with ## for a heading, 1. for a numbered step, - for a bullet. Put commands between two lines of ```. Wrap short names in backticks. To put sections in a slider, write ::: slides, start each slide with @slide Title, and end with :::.
